senses.definition: (intransitive, stative) To perceive sounds through the ear.
examples: I was deaf, but now I can hear.

senses.definition: (transitive, stative) To perceive (a sound, or something producing a sound) with the ear, to recognize (something) in an auditory way.
examples: I could hear them quarreling upstairs, but didn’t really listen to their argument.

senses.definition: (transitive) To listen favourably to; to grant (a request etc.).
examples: Eventually the king chose to hear her entreaties.

senses.definition: (transitive) To receive information about; to come to learn of.

senses.definition: (transitive, law) To listen to (a person, case) in a court of law; to try.
examples: Your case will be heard at the end of the month.

senses.definition: (transitive, informal) To sympathize with; to understand the feelings or opinion of.
examples: You're tired of all the ads on TV? I hear ya.
